_about: Standing decisions from Corentin. Every agent reads this file and must not raise these as problems. Updated 21 Oct 2026.

intentional_blocks.note: Notting Hill, Bayswater, Marylebone and Woolwich calendars are blocked on purpose. Blocked nights are not demand and not lost revenue: exclude them from opportunity and occupancy-gap findings.

special_setups.P14: Primrose Hill pricing (incl. the £500 minimum) is a deliberate special setup. Do not propose changing its min, base or min-stay; report its numbers only.

booking_visibility_booster: Booking.com Visibility Booster is raised on selected dates on purpose, so commission above 15% on those bookings is expected. Only flag commission that is above 15% AND not explained by the booster (ask before assuming).

length_of_stay_discounts.note: Same discounts on Airbnb and Booking.com (Airbnb screenshot 18 Oct 2026). A stay of 7-27 nights is expected 15% under the nightly price, 28+ nights 20% under. Only the gap beyond that is a leak.

linked_listings.P13: Smoobu 3064856 and 3090701 are ONE Shepherd's Bush flat. Their bookings are combined; nights blocked on one because the other is booked are bookings, not blocks.

property_facts.P05: St John's Wood (Abbey Rd): 4 bedrooms, 5 beds including a sofa bed (Corentin, 18 Oct 2026). PriceLabs shows 4 bedrooms since 19 Oct 2026; benchmark against 4-bed listings.

channel_pricing.booking_markup_note: Smoobu adds +20% to the PriceLabs price on Booking.com (confirmed by Corentin 20 Oct 2026). Expected Booking price = 1.2 x PriceLabs, before stay discounts.
channel_pricing.booking_stacked_promotions: Corentin confirms Booking.com promotions stack on top of each other (20 Oct 2026). A Booking paid rate below 1.2 x price after stay discounts is explained by these promotions: report its size, do not call it unexplained.
channel_pricing.airbnb_discount: Corentin confirms an Airbnb discount is active beyond the 15%/20% stay discounts (20 Oct 2026); type and % not yet given. The Airbnb paid-vs-price gap is explained by it: keep measuring its size, do not call it unexplained.

separate_payments.P20: Waterford Court Airbnb stay extended from 18 to 22 Oct 2026: the extra nights were paid separately (Corentin, 20 Oct 2026), so the Smoobu reservation total does not include them. Do not flag; P20 last-30 ADR is understated for 18-22 Oct.

handbacks.note: Flats being given back to their owners after these dates (Corentin, 21 Oct 2026). The Smoobu 'Blocked channel' blocks created 19 Oct mark the end of our management. Nights after the date are not inventory: exclude them from occupancy, opportunity and lost-demand findings, and propose nothing for them. Before the date, maximise revenue normally.
